summary: Implemented the window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the title sequence "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" to CONTROL_CODES_FORMAT and a Control.title(title) classmethod with a docstring. rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, buffering the control only when is_terminal is true. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one branch calling term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skipped on win32), test_control_title, and test_control_set_window_title (Windows only). Not run: tests, Black, and mypy, per instructions. No commits made.
